VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Fast forward to today. In FY25, MERCEDES-BENZ made 132.2 BILLION EUROS in revenue. BMW made 133.5 BILLION EUROS. But MERCEDES made 5.3 BILLION EUROS in profit. BMW made 7.45 BILLION EUROS. The company that was about to be sold for scraps to Mercedes is now BIGGER, more PROFITABLE, and more LOVED than the company that tried to buy it. And this transformation didn't happen because BMW built better engines. It happened because of one insight that will change how you think about MARKETING, POSITIONING, and BRAND STRATEGY forever.
